summary: Verified 9-tool Admin Panel restoration and BonusBanner integration. Backend pytest suite (test_admin_tools.py) 10/10 passed. UI smoke via Playwright confirmed: admin login works, /admin shows all 9 tool cards (data-testid admin-tool-*), navigation into each tool works, and non-destructive interactions succeed. Bonus banner appears on 3/4 game pages for QA player (survival not shown = user not eligible / no active bonus for survival, which is expected).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <option>. Caused by dev instrumentation wrappers (x-source-var / x-excluded span) injected around option's dynamic text. Only visible in dev build; produces console error. Consider ejecting/disabling that instrumentation on <option> elements or wrapping text differently.

critical_code_review_comments: BonusBanner testid semantics differ from request wording: banner uses game prop values 'tiket','survival','score','fanta' (matching backend /api/bonus/available game=... regex), producing testids bonus-banner-tiket / bonus-banner-score / bonus-banner-fanta / bonus-banner-survival. Request mentioned 'bonus-banner-{game}' referencing route names (survival/tiket/scoreandlive/fanta) — actual naming is consistent with backend game codes; not a bug.
GestioneAdmin lists admins with data-testid ga-admin-<id> (delete btn ga-del-<id>), while task description mentioned ga-user-* — actual naming is fine and consistent within the component.
DeadlineGiornate row testid is dl-row-<md>, not dl-list. Actual naming is per-row (better) and works correctly.

Dev-mode source-instrumentation adds a nested <span> inside <option> in GestioneBonus.js:86 causing a React hydration console warning. Not a functional bug but noisy in DevTools. Safe to ignore in prod build; consider stripping instrumentation on <option> children.
